rows.label: Statement
rows.text: With pinned Lean and Mathlib versions, “Discharge PO-090 with definitions whose types separate a p-derivation from an ordinary derivation, proofs of the sum and product identities including p = 2, compatibility with the induced Frobenius lift, executable regression examples, no admitted declarations, and an axiom report containing only the approved logical foundations.”

rows.label: What the source establishes
rows.text: “This ranks second because the mathematics is known and the acceptance test is finite.” Failures of tooling do not count against the mathematics: “A library or elaboration failure is an engineering result, not a refutation.” The repository gives the statements in Lean (formal/GrothendieckianProblems/P49.lean).
